vulnerability_analysis: The Auth.transferOwnership() function sets authorizations[newOwner] = true but doesn't remove authorizations[previousOwner]. This allows the previous owner to retain authorization even after ownership transfer, violating access control principles.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate current owner. 2. Transfer ownership to a new address. 3. Verify previous owner remains authorized. 4. Call authorized function from previous owner to demonstrate privilege retention.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the current owner. 2. Call transferOwnership() to transfer to a new address. 3. Check that authorizations[previousOwner] == true. 4. Call setFeeReceivers() from previous owner to demonstrate unauthorized access.
